rationale: The hash-pinned source defines finite Lp only for p>0, defines L-infinity by essential supremum, then mistakenly prints p=0 in Equation (1.3). Under this task's explicit CORRECTED scope, ENNReal p!=0 with p<=q exactly represents 0<p<=q<=infinity, including subunit exponents and infinity while avoiding Mathlib's totalized zero branch. The same X, probability measure, Lp operators, and inequality direction are preserved. AE strong measurability changes only representatives, so both implications hold. The target is faithful-equivalent to the corrected claim but intentionally not to the ill-defined literal p=0 wording.
